title: calystegia macrostegia subsp. intermedia
intro: Calystegia macrostegia subsp. intermedia, commonly known as Island Morning Glory, is a species of flowering plant in the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits, including reducing inflammation and pain, as well as exhibiting antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Island Morning Glory include sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of insomnia, muscle spasms, and anxiety disorders. The bioactive constituents of Island Morning Glory include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
